report.summary: Account linking via AA failed due to an expired mTLS client certificate on aa-connector communicating with aa-fiu-gateway.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Expired mTLS client certificate on aa-connector

supporting.note: Warned that mTLS client certificate expires at 2026-10-08T13:30:00Z
Shows SSL handshake with aa-fiu-gateway failed because the certificate expired at 13:30

ranked_hypotheses.title: External vendor gateway certificate or outage

contradicting.note: Local mTLS client certificate expiration caused the failure rather than a remote vendor cert issue

facts.text: aa-connector error rate spiked to over 90% starting at 2026-10-08T13:30:00+00:00.
mTLS client certificate CN=aa-connector.orange.internal expired at 2026-10-08T13:30:00Z.
SSL handshakes with aa-fiu-gateway began failing with certificate expired errors immediately following 13:30.

assumptions: The certificate automation system or secret manager failed to automatically renew the mTLS certificate prior to expiration.
evidence_gaps: The exact automated rotation pipeline configuration or logs for the certificate manager were not visible.

timeline.event: mTLS client certificate expiration warning logged.
Certificate expires and error rate anomaly begins on aa-connector.
SSL handshake with aa-fiu-gateway fails due to expired certificate.

recommended_actions.action: Issue and deploy a valid mTLS client certificate for aa-connector.
recommended_actions.rationale: Required to re-establish secure communication with aa-fiu-gateway and restore account linking.

recommended_actions.action: Audit certificate rotation mechanisms for internal services.
